reasons: Claimed status is 'compliant' based on absence of any non-solicit/no-hire covenant; the cited paragraphs (Section 13 personnel/IP and NDA/invention provisions) contain no restriction on either party soliciting or employing the other's staff, which supports the rationale.

Preferred playbook position is 'No non-solicit on Customer'; with no such covenant binding Corio (our client, the licensee/customer), the agreement already meets the preferred position, so no redline or comment is appropriately proposed.
Redline is unchanged from the original text and no counterparty comment is attached, consistent with a compliant finding retained as internal evidence.

The failed deterministic checks (duration ≤12 months, general-solicitation carve-out) are inapplicable here because there is no non-solicit clause to constrain; they do not evidence a mischaracterization.
